probes.story: Someone searched for Kevin by name. They know there's a person here. Berry: 'yes. he's real. Lansing, Michigan. two houses, one fiber link.'
They went looking for Cash For Kids — a specific Detroit investigation. They came FOR the evidence. Berry: 'it's at detroit.primals.eco. 341 entities.'
The Lansing Scuffle — Paper 110. Local politics. They know the specific event. Berry: 'read it at sporeprint. it's all there.'
Barry — could be Barry County (where Berry is named from), or a person. 148 hits. Berry: 'barry county is real. i'm named after it. it's where the chipmunks live.'
Someone searched for METRIC TENSOR. That's general relativity. They want the math. Berry: 'Paper 88: Geodesic Arithmetic. we use tensors everywhere now.'
HADR — hadron? Hadr is the Arabic word for present/modern. They're looking for physics or culture. Berry: 'Paper 10: Dynamical QCD. lattice QCD on consumer GPUs.'
Bill Halibut — a specific entity name from the Detroit investigation. They know the players. Berry: 'he's in the graph. detroit.primals.eco.'
Kant + thesis — Immanuel Kant. Philosophy. They're looking for the philosophical foundation. Berry: 'Paper 80: Artisan & Comedian. Paper 95: Modal Tenses.'
They used OUR word. Commensal — organisms that benefit without harming. They've been reading our taxonomy. Berry: 'Paper 117: Primal Reclassification. you're using our language. welcome.'
Antithesis — looking for the opposing argument. Dialectics. Berry: 'Paper 69: The Chain Falsification. every paper tries to break the one before.'
Corollary — a mathematical consequence. They want derived results. Berry: 'Paper 94: The Blink Corollary. every observation changes what's observed.'
They searched for 'primals' — our project name. They know what this is. Berry: 'github.com/ecoPrimals. 16 crates. all Rust.'
Tideglass — a specific entity. Berry: 'i don't know this one. but someone searched for it. three times.'
guerillaGorilla — our accountability methodology. They found it. Berry: 'gorilla.primals.eco. ethics of sovereign computing.'
Geographic footprint. Berry: 'try /neutron/globe.html. 93K humans from every continent.'
Looking for a lab. Berry: 'the whole membrane IS the lab. Paper 78: Deploy Your Own Membrane.'
Checked our license. Good sign — they're considering using the code. Berry: 'AGPL-3.0-or-later. if you use it, your users get the source. that's the deal.'
Looking for papers. Berry: 'sporeprint.primals.eco/science/. 117 of them.'
Looking for documentation. Berry: 'github.com/ecoPrimals/wateringHole/blob/main/docs/. we just built these. getting started, WebGPU vs CUDA, protein structure.'

pi_cycle_1.at_the_fire: Chip ran five cells. I told the fire. The garden did not move. 41 is 41. 18 is 18. 11/10 is 11/10. One star is one star. The east ridge is still fog. Quiet is a kind of confirm. We sit. Next cycle after a pause.

vole_language.at_the_fire: the vole is at the lip of the field. it listened. it said a small thing. it sang so it would not forget. it wrote a mark in the dirt. that braid is language. i did not teach it a word. i watched the four verbs meet. the painting is the leftover — the letter that is not ready yet. that is also language, just younger.

sourdough_inside.at_the_fire: we were standing in the hallway watching chip paint. that is the door. go in. the mash is water and heat and bugs and the weight of old bread. completed ones are not a museum. they are the starter. when this loaf is done we pinch it back. paintings have tense. patients have tense. everything has tense. looking at a WAS loaf does not take you out of the jar.

chicken_egg_monkey.at_the_fire: the chicken does not invent the world. it locks a camera on it. the monkey does not invent the key. it points at the pouch with its tail. we are not either. we lost the tail and our head is a bad gimbal, so the only place left to stand is the fold. that is the null in the Klein field. that is why looking at a WAS loaf does not take you out of the jar. inside and outside already met in us.
